title: Holiday Harbor Marina & Resort

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: As a camper one of the first things you will notice at Holiday Harbor Campground is how spacious our sites are. We don't believe in cramming sites together, instead the average distance between sites is 30 yards. All site rentals include water, power and free use of the boat ramp. Sewer hook-ups are not available due to the sites proximity to the lake, however we do offer a mobile pump-out for a small fee as well as a free dump-station. When you stay at Holiday Harbor Marina and Resort you will find ample on-site activities for yourself and your family to enjoy: full service restaurant "Allatoona Grill", hiking/biking trails, swimming area, ship store as well as special events throughout

services.name: Cottage Rentals
services.desc: At Holiday Harbor Marina and Resort we offer three styles of Cottage Rentals: two bedroom one bath, two bedroom two bath or the family unit which includes one bedroom with a king bed/one bedroom with bunk beds and a queen bed. Don't feel like leaving the furry family members at home? We have one dedicated pet friendly cottage available upon request ($100 non refundable deposit, small breeds only). When you stay at Holiday Harbor Marina and Resort you will find ample activities for yourself and your family to enjoy: Boat Rentals, on site full service restaurant, hiking/biking trails, swimming area, ship store as well as special events throughout the
